title: ALICE: In-context, Zero-shot, Mutual Information Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.34962v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating mutual information (MI) from samples is a central objective in a variety of scientific fields. Modern neural estimators are accurate in the large-data regime, but they fall short when data is scarce, and each must be fit anew for every distribution under study. Current estimators are moreover tied to specific data types. These constraints limit their adoption in many applications where per-distribution training is impractical and sample sizes are small.   We present ALICE, a foundation model that removes per-distribution training, while achieving competitive estimation accuracy. Trained exclusively on a broad family of synthetic distributions, ALICE acts as an in-context estimator of rectified-flow velocity fields: conditioned on samples of an unseen distribution, it estimates that distribution's velocity field without any explicit training. translated_title: ALICE：上下文内、零样本的互信息估计
translated_abstract: 从样本中估计互信息（MI）是众多科学领域的核心目标。现代神经估计器在大数据情形下表现准确，但在数据稀缺时则力有不逮，且每个被研究的分布都必须重新拟合一次。此外，目前的估计器还绑定于特定的数据类型。这些限制阻碍了它们在许多应用中的采用，因为在这些应用中针对每个分布单独训练并不现实，且样本量很小。我们提出了ALICE，一个免除了针对每个分布训练、同时实现具有竞争力的估计精度的基础模型。ALICE仅在一个广泛的合成分布族上训练，它充当修正流速度场的上下文内估计器：以未见分布的样本为条件，它无需任何显式训练即可估计该分布的速度场。随后，互信息通过一个固定恒等式对平方差进行积分而获得……
tldr: ALICE是一个仅通过合成分布训练的基础模型，它作为修正流速度场的上下文内估计器，实现了零样本、无需针对每个分布单独训练的互信息估计，在数据稀缺时仍具有竞争力。
en_tdlr: ALICE is a foundation model trained solely on synthetic distributions that acts as an in-context, zero-shot estimator of rectified-flow velocity fields, enabling mutual information estimation without per-distribution training while remaining competitive even when data is scarce.
